scenes.headline: filter()
scenes.subtitle: Keeping only the rows that match a condition.
scenes.narration: The filter transformation keeps only the rows that satisfy a condition, letting you narrow a dataset.

scenes.headline: What filter does
items: Keeps rows where the condition is true
where() is an identical alias for filter()
Conditions can combine with & and | operators
Pushed down to the source when possible
scenes.narration: Filter keeps only rows where the condition is true, and where is an identical alias. Conditions can be combined with the and and or operators, and Spark can push filters down to the source to read less data.

scenes.headline: Filtering with combined conditions
scenes.narration: We filter for rows where the region equals EMEA and the amount exceeds one thousand. Notice each condition is wrapped in parentheses and joined with the ampersand operator, which Spark requires instead of Python's and keyword.

scenes.text: Filter as early as possible so downstream steps process fewer rows.
scenes.narration: Apply filters as early as possible so every downstream step processes fewer rows and the job runs faster.
